Nina Alvarez: Heads up campus intern (Leah Chen) arriving a day early to SF for orientation. She only has an emailed I-9 appointment confirmation, original passport arrives tomorrow. Can we do Day 0 badge+desk access for a campus tour?
Josh Meyer: Facilities can do a supervised tour and a 2-hour visitor badge, but HR must log an I-9 pending exception. Also need pre-signed visitor form + photo ID scan.
Alicia Gomez: HR here 2 we can log the exception. Onboarding tasks: have Leah upload the appointment confirmation and a signed SSN attestation if she has it. We prefer originals within 3 business days.
Nina Alvarez: She sent a university letter and a scanned passport page. Uploading now.
Onboard Bot: Case created: I9-CASE-2026-9001. Doc links requested.
Security: Temporary badge OK for 2 hours with escort. Escort assigned: Marco. No access to secure systems.
Facilities: Desk space reserved for 10:00-12:00 in Welcome Bay. Code RED-WLC-11 for pickup.
Alicia Gomez: Note for benefits and payroll: interns get pro-rated stipend setup; payroll needs bank info by end of week. Leah can complete W-4 and direct deposit after tour via kiosk.
Nina Alvarez: Thanks team 2 Leah confirmed she'll be at lobby 09:45 with scanned docs. We'll keep Day 0 light.
Josh Meyer: All set. Reminder: follow up for original I-9 docs within 3 days to avoid access block.
Nina Alvarez: Appreciated. See you tomorrow!
